FloPlast 110mm push-fit soil pipes are designed for efficient wastewater management and form essential components of any drainage system. Manufactured from robust uPVC for strength and long-lasting durability, this lightweight black soil stack pipe facilitates straightforward installation. The single socket design and push-fit system with ring seal joints allow for quick and secure connections, ideal for plumbers and builders installing new soil stacks or undertaking repair work. It is also suitable for handling high temperature waste discharges, ensuring reliable performance in various applications.
